description: ChunkedSpeechBuffer.asContiguousArray() uses flatMap which is O(n). Consider lazy evaluation for large buffers.
remediation: For very large buffers, consider returning a custom Sequence view instead of flattening eagerly.

description: Multi-channel mixing uses scalar loop before vDSP. Could use vDSP_vgathr for better vectorization.
remediation: For >2 channels, pre-extract all channels with vDSP then mix pairwise for full vectorization.

description: resampleBuffer is preallocated but capacity not reserved. May cause reallocation during resampling.
remediation: Reserve capacity based on expected maximum resample output size.
